proof_domain_audit.shock: Unanticipated permanent productivity, immediate renegotiation and vacancy adjustment permit constant future individual hazards independent of current u. Employment stocks remain continuous; anticipated/temporary/recurrent shocks need omitted continuation derivatives.
proof_domain_audit.planner: Explicit y>b, real b, common initial u, same financing authority. Locally bounded measurable theta yields absolutely continuous feasible state. Bounded benefits and finite discounted costs give objective limit; global stage inequality plus bounded affine remainder proves attainment against time-varying alternatives. Strict g and positive u establish uniqueness almost everywhere.
proof_domain_audit.hosios: Identical roots when eta=alpha plus unique inverse bargaining weight at a given positive theta proves necessity. Claims limited to stipulated CRS transferable-utility model with exogenous separation; UI transfers and distributional compensation require added accounts.
proof_domain_audit.financing: Owner assets/frictionless enforceable claims stipulated; sufficient reserves cover baseline/shock flows, exact recruiting present value smaller. Recruiting deducted once and wage transfers canceled. No aggregate interest-rate or unrestricted finance theorem claimed.
